	pass
input.solution:
extends Node2D


func _ready() -> void:
	InputMap.add_action("dash")
	var key = InputEventKey.new()
	key.physical_keycode = KEY_SPACE
	InputMap.action_add_event("dash", key)
	$Status.text = "Space → dash"
	var press = InputEventKey.new()
	press.physical_keycode = KEY_SPACE
	press.pressed = true
	Input.parse_input_event(press)
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if Input.is_action_pressed("dash"):
		$Player.position.x = 200
	press.pressed = false
	Input.parse_input_event(press)

	image.fill(Color.WHITE)
	var surface = Sprite2D.new()
	surface.name = "Surface"
	surface.texture = ImageTexture.create_from_image(image)

shader-uv.solution:
extends Node2D


func _ready() -> void:
	var image = Image.create(64,64,false,Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
	image.fill(Color.WHITE)
	var surface = Sprite2D.new()
	surface.name = "Surface"
	surface.texture = ImageTexture.create_from_image(image)
	surface.position = Vector2(320,180)
	surface.scale = Vector2(3,3)
	var shader = Shader.new()
	shader.code = "shader_type canvas_item; uniform float repeats=1.0; void fragment(){float stripe=step(0.5,fract(UV.x*repeats));COLOR=vec4(vec3(stripe),1.0);}"
	var material = ShaderMaterial.new()
	material.shader = shader
	surface.material = material
	add_child(surface)
	$Player.visible = false
	material.set_shader_parameter("repeats",4.0)
	$Status.text = "UV 반복으로 줄무늬 만들기"
